safety.label:
«requirement»
Safety
The Range Safety Officer
shall command UHF destruct
from outside Mission Control
until that command is safed
after Earth orbit.

land.label:
«requirement»
Land
The Lunar Module shall land
two crew on the Moon under
Primary Guidance program P66.

talk.label:
«requirement»
Talk
The stack shall communicate
with Mission Control on
Unified S-Band.

abort.label:
«requirement»
Abort
The Abort Guidance System
shall provide abort guidance
without landing the Lunar
Module.

air.label:
«requirement»
Air
The Lunar Module shall supply
oxygen, water, and lithium
hydroxide for life support.

guide.label:
«requirement»
Guide
The Lunar Module Primary
Guidance system shall use
landing radar during descent
and rendezvous radar during
ascent.
